facts.value: The Department of Economics offers the program Business Chinese with conceptual support and guidance from the field of Sinology. This program consists of 4 courses, starting with a course for beginners without prior knowledge.
The offerings include levels A1 (Basic Course Chinese) and A2 (Business Chinese) according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
After completing the entire program, oral proficiency at approximately level A1 of the GER should be achieved.
No prior knowledge is required for this module.
The goal of this course is to acquire basic subject vocabulary and solidify knowledge of the basic structures of the Chinese language.
After this course, students should be able to conduct simple dialogues in Chinese and cope linguistically with typical situations of everyday life as well as from tourist and business stays in China.

They are expected to acquire linguistic and intercultural competencies as well as knowledge about Chinese culture and society, beneficial for activities in Chinese-German economic relations and for establishing and maintaining contacts with Chinese partners.
Reading comprehension and writing competence are assessed through a 90-minute exam in the last week of lectures. A graded certificate is issued for passing the exam.
The number of participants is limited to a maximum of 20.
Unit 1 – Chinese pronunciation; Unit 2 – Greetings, introducing oneself; Unit 3 – Exchanging simple information; Unit 4 – About family; Unit 5 – About different things.
Details about the textbook will be provided in the first class.
This course is only offered in the winter semester.
